actions.name: spider climb
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the target has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.

actions.name: web walker
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: web strand
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=Ln5NXBaHGKlwdoiP]], one Large or smaller [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=Ln5NXBaHGKlwdoiP]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=Ln5NXBaHGKlwdoiP]] feet. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .mmBite0000000000]] attack and one [[/item .mmClaw0000000000]] attack.

actions.name: reel
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} pulls [[lookup @target.affects.labels.statblock activity=jWkEQYHBd7aht1kG]] within [[lookup @range.value activity=jWkEQYHBd7aht1kG]] feet of itself that is Restrained by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.
